EmailTemplate.name: Communities: User Lockout Email w/Letterhead
EmailTemplate.subject: You've been locked out of {!Community.Name}
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Hello {!Receiving_User.Username},
We received your request to reset your {!Community.Name} password. We can't reset your password right now. Your account is locked after too many login attempts.
If you didn't request a password reset or haven't tried to log in to your account recently, contact your {!Community.Name} administrator or reply to this email.
Thank you, {!Community.Name}
